Redirect checker

Paste any authorisation endpoint, redirect URI or origin. This probes the deep-link verification files at that origin: - Pass — a 200 serving valid JSON as application/json. - Warn — a wrong Content-Type. - Fail — a redirect, non-200, non-JSON body or network error. - n/a — Huawei applinking.json (HarmonyOS App Linking) only. This file is not required, so an absent one is informational, not a failure, and never affects the headline verdict. These are the same rules as the redirect testing page (built to check published production authorization_endpoint s).
